name: io.github.tonyyang0504/wix_stores-mcp
description: Wix Stores (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WIX_STORES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account API key from the Wix API Key Manager (account owner; Wix Stores + eCommerce scopes, site access) sent raw in the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WIX_STORES_SITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Site id of the store (API keys are account-level, so every site-level call must carry the wix-site-id header).
